name: ats-jobs-aggregator
title: ATS Jobs Scraper: Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby
description: Get every open job from any company's Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby or Workable job board in one clean format, or monitor a list of companies and get only new and closed roles each run. Give it a domain or career site link and it finds the board. Salaries where posted, remote flags, filters.
